nodes.label: NewCommand
nodes.desc: Cobra root command; RunE builds a Collector and calls Run

nodes.label: --config / --set flags
nodes.desc: Registers the config flag (one URI per entry) and the set flag for overrides

nodes.label: otelcol components
nodes.desc: Subcommand listing every factory, provider and converter built into the binary

nodes.label: Collector struct
nodes.desc: Holds settings, config provider, Service, state and shutdown channels

nodes.label: NewCollector
nodes.desc: Creates buffered logging cores and the ConfigProvider

nodes.label: Collector.Run
nodes.desc: Starts everything, then selects on watch, async errors, SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP and shutdown

nodes.label: setupConfigurationComponents
nodes.desc: Resolves config, validates it, builds the Service and starts it

nodes.label: reloadConfiguration
nodes.desc: Shuts down the retiring config and rebuilds the Service; supports partial receiver reload

nodes.label: ConfigProvider
nodes.desc: Wraps the confmap Resolver; Get returns the unmarshalled Config, Watch streams changes

nodes.label: Resolver.Resolve
nodes.desc: Fetches each URI via its provider, merges maps in order, runs converters

nodes.label: Resolver.Watch
nodes.desc: Channel that fires when any watched config location changes

nodes.label: file provider
nodes.desc: Reads local config files for the file: scheme

nodes.label: env provider
nodes.desc: Serves environment variables for the env: scheme

nodes.label: otelcol.Config.Validate
nodes.desc: Top-level config maps plus checks that receivers, exporters and references exist

nodes.label: Factories
nodes.desc: Maps component types to receiver/processor/exporter/connector/extension factories

nodes.label: service.New
nodes.desc: Creates resource, logger, meter and tracer providers, then initializes the flow graph

nodes.label: Service.Start
nodes.desc: Starts extensions first, then the graph, then signals everything is ready

nodes.label: Service.Shutdown
nodes.desc: Stops the graph, extensions and telemetry in reverse creation order

nodes.label: initGraph
nodes.desc: Assembles graph.Settings from builders and the configured signal flows

nodes.label: graph.Host
nodes.desc: component.Host: builders per kind, status reporter, zPages, async error channel

nodes.label: graph.Build
nodes.desc: Creates nodes, connects edges and instantiates components in reverse topological order

nodes.label: createNodes
nodes.desc: Adds receiver, processor, exporter and connector nodes; validates connector usage

nodes.label: createEdges
nodes.desc: Receivers into a capabilities node, processor chain, then a fan-out before exporters

nodes.label: buildComponents
nodes.desc: Topologically sorts the DAG and builds each component with its next consumers

nodes.label: StartAll
nodes.desc: Starts components downstream-first so every consumer is ready before its producer

nodes.label: receiverNode
nodes.desc: Shared across same-signal flows; wraps next consumers in fan-out plus obsconsumer

nodes.label: processorNode
nodes.desc: Unique per flow; wraps both consumed and produced sides with metrics

nodes.label: exporterNode
nodes.desc: Consumes pdata via obsconsumer and refconsumer wrappers

nodes.label: connectorNode
nodes.desc: Bridges two flows: exporter on one side, receiver on the other

nodes.label: capabilitiesNode
nodes.desc: Virtual first consumer that reports aggregated MutatesData capabilities

nodes.label: fanOutNode
nodes.desc: Clones or duplicates data to every exporter of a flow

nodes.label: ptrace.Traces
nodes.desc: ResourceSpans slice; the OTLP-native trace container

nodes.label: pmetric.Metrics
nodes.desc: ResourceMetrics slice carrying gauges, sums, histograms and more

nodes.label: plog.Logs
nodes.desc: ResourceLogs slice with scope and record layers
